titleStmt.title: Shiji 史记 · 周赧王五十九年: introductions

div.p: The Basic Annals for 256 BC, the year in which Qin extinguished Western Zhou: the entry of the Basic Annals of Zhou under the fifty-ninth year of King Nan, and the entry of the Basic Annals of Qin under the fifty-first year of King Zhaoxiang, which record the same events from the two sides.
The row of the Table of the Six States for this year. The Table runs the states in parallel columns, one line to a state; only the states with an entry for the year appear.
The entries of the Hereditary Houses for this year: the houses of Chu, Zhao and Han, each under its own count of years.

The Biographies: the biography of the Prince of Wei, Lord Xinling, entire; the passage of the biography of Fan Ju and Cai Ze in which Cai Ze becomes Chancellor and Qin takes in the house of Zhou; and the lines of the biography of Lian Po and Lin Xiangru on the siege of Handan.
The Biographies, continued: the passage of the biography of Lü Buwei on Zichu's escape from Handan.
Ivar the Boneless' commentary on the year, with his analyses (辨析) and the texts he adduces: chapter 25 of the Zhanguo Zonghengjia Shu and a passage of the Han Feizi.
Ivar the Boneless' commentary, continued: Han's recovery of Runan, Wei's seizure of Tao and Wey, Li Mu's northern command and Chunshen's conquest of Lu, each with its analysis.
Other works: the preliminary report on the Shenheyuan tomb at Chang'an, whose dated inscription of the fifty-ninth year ties it to this year.
The Eight Treatises: the sentence of the Treatise on the Feng and Shan Sacrifices on the passing of the Nine Tripods to Qin.
